faq.purchaseQuestion: Can I buy a rank with money?
faq.purchaseAnswer: No. Ranks are bought with credits only, and credits cannot be purchased. Nobody gets ahead here by paying.
faq.earnAnswer: By taking part: visiting every day, starting threads, replying, receiving reactions, keeping a weekly streak and earning awards. The credits page lists every way to earn.
faq.upgradeQuestion: Can I move to a higher rank later?
faq.upgradeAnswer: You can. You only pay the difference in credits between your current rank and the new one, and you keep the award and the name colour you already unlocked.
faq.expiryAnswer: No. A rank is bought once and stays with your account, together with everything it unlocks.
faq.donorAnswer: A one-time contribution of $12.50 towards the costs of running the forum. It adds a small badge next to your name and nothing else: no rank, no credits, no extra features.
faq.demoAnswer: No. This forum is a demo, so the donation button does not charge anything and no payment details are collected.
